# What would make Dopbase more useful for your workflow?

What task would you like Dopbase to make easier?

Describe the task, what gets in your way today, and how you handle it now. You do not need to design the solution.

[Search existing requests](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase/discussions/categories/ideas) before opening a separate thread. If someone has described the same problem, add your use case there.

Maintainers will link accepted work to an issue. A request starts a conversation; it does not set a release date.
